summary: 58-year-old man (hometown unknown) drove off Trail Ridge Road near Gore Range Overlook ~8:30 p.m. Friday; vehicle rolled numerous times ~500 ft downslope. The driver crawled out and sat beside the car all night; a visitor spotted the vehicle below the road ~7:30 a.m. Saturday and notified the park. The driver had multiple injuries and was flown by Lifeguard 72 (Firestone) to Medical Center of the Rockies.
location: Trail Ridge Road near Gore Range Overlook, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Parent-opened Estes Park News article ('last Friday evening'; next morning = Saturday July 26, 2014, so incident Friday 2014-07-25, Friday-verified). Run 821 RMNP chunk.
